title: Smoke over the Vale
summary: Maudry Fenn at the Tired Mule says the Redhand Company, deserters turned bandits, are squatting in the Tithe Mill again and burning the miller's carts. The Vale's tithe grain goes through that mill, and she wants them gone.

steps.journal: Go to the Tithe Mill, up the river from Thornwick, and drive the Redhand out: hold four waves there.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Tithe Mill

ready: Tell Osric Hale, at the Watch post by Thornwick's well, that the mill is clear. He'll ask where they went.
done: You drove the Redhand out of the Tithe Mill. They went to Wickham Keep; Osric Hale wrote it down.
